## Terms

### time series collection

- **time series collection** · self — Time series collections support [secondary indexes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/timeseries/timeseries-secondary-index.md#std-label-timeseries-add-secondary-index) on the field specified as the `metaField`. If the data model of your time series data does not have a designated field for y · aka: time series collections, time-series collection, time-series collections, timeseries, time series, time-series, timeseries collection — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/timeseries/timeseries-migrate-with-tools.md#steps

### metaField

- **metaField** · part — `{ metaField: ±1, timeField: ±1 }` when there is a point predicate on `<metaField>` · aka: metaField, meta field, metadata field, timeField, time field, granularity, bucketMaxSpanSeconds, bucketRoundingSeconds, bucketing, bucket boundaries, bucket span, system.buckets, bucket document, bucket documents, bucket unpacking, unpack, $_internalUnpackBucket, _internalUnpackBucket, bucket catalog, bucketing parameters, control.min, control.max, time series bucket, time series buckets, bucketed — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/timeseries/timeseries-secondary-index.md#use-secondary-indexes-to-improve-sort-performance

### secondary index on time series

- **secondary index on time series** · part · aka: secondary index, secondary indexes, index on the metaField, index on metaField, compound index on the metaField, timeseries-secondary-index, timeseries index, time series index, index on timeField, partial index on time series, 2dsphere on time series, multikey index on time series, clustered index, _id index on buckets

### metaField cardinality

- **metaField cardinality** · problem · aka: high cardinality metaField, cardinality, unique metaField, too many buckets, one document per bucket, bucket fill, sparse buckets, small buckets, bucket churn, anti-pattern, anti-patterns, antipattern, best practices, considerations, limitations

### block processing

- **block processing** · part — Block processing applies to aggregation pipelines that begin with $match, with $sort on the timeField only, or with $group. A MongoDB blog also names $setWindowFields as an analytical stage that benefits, but gives no complete list of supported operators. · aka: block processing, block-based processing, Block Processing, vectorized, columnar execution — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.2/core/timeseries/timeseries-querying/

### time series query

- **time series query** · part · aka: $match on timeField, range query on timeField, time range query, $group by time, $dateTrunc, downsampling, last point, last point query, most recent measurement, $sort on timeField, sort by time, bounded sort, $sort optimization, predicate pushdown, $match pushdown, timeseries query, querying a time series collection, aggregation on time series

### working set for time series

- **working set for time series** · measure · aka: working set, WiredTiger cache, memory footprint, storage size, compression, columnar compression, bucket size, bucket count, timeseriesBucketMaxCount, timeseriesBucketMaxSize, compaction, sizing, capacity

### time series sharding

- **time series sharding** · related · aka: shard a time series collection, sharded time series, shard key for time series, meta field shard key

### index

- **index** · related — Index hints cause MongoDB to use a specific index for a query. Some operations on time series collections can only take advantage of an index if that index is specified in a hint. · aka: indexes, indexed, IXSCAN, COLLSCAN, explain, executionStats — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/timeseries/timeseries-secondary-index.md#specify-index-hints-for-time-series-collections
